reason.description: Why, in one or two sentences, naming the rule ids.

cites.description: Rule ids: a contract line, a P<n>, a record id, an AGENTS.md section, an issue number, a research line.

primitive.description: P1..P7 from PRIMITIVES.md, or NEW for a new call.

how.description: restores = makes the code keep a line the contract already states

comment.description: The comment the runner posts on the issue.

openRisks.description: none, or the issue id plus who reads it. One line.

duplicateOf.description: The issue this one repeats, or 0.

decidedBy.description: The id of an accepted, signed record that already decides exactly what this issue asks (for example a record that forbids it), or empty. A record that is only a constraint on how to build is not this.

brief.description: For build: Intent, Acceptance, Boundaries. Else empty.

question.description: For ask: what the owner decides, in one sentence. Else empty.

text.description: For ask: the whole record from decisions/TEMPLATE.md. Else empty.

options.description: For ask: the record's options, in order. Else empty.

brief.description: What to build if the owner picks this. Empty for decline.

recommendation.description: For ask: the option number. Else 0.

path.description: Path and query on the live address, starting with /.

includes.description: Short strings the body must include.
